about.title: About me
about.note: Web applications, from the data model to production.
about.quote: At LKS NEXT I build and maintain production applications for public institutions, and I work across the whole cycle: data model, API, interface and deployment.
about.bio1: Computer Engineering graduate from UPV/EHU. I've been at LKS NEXT for {years} years: first as an intern, building my thesis as an internal product (a knowledge-management app that generates CVs for tenders), and now as a junior developer.
about.bio2: Before that, at Formula Student Bizkaia, I developed path planning in Python and ROS2 for the autonomous car, and I was technical lead of the simulation event at FSUK 2024 (Silverstone).
